strategy_roster.name: Ichimoku Oscillator
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema((close - (donchian_high(high,52) + donchian_low(low,52)) / 2) - ((donchian_high(high,9) + donchian_low(low,9)) / 2 - (donchian_high(high,26) + donchian_low(low,26)) / 2),10),ema((close - (donchian_high(high,52) + donchian_low(low,52)) / 2) - ((donchian_high(high,9) + donchian_low(low,9)) / 2 - (donchian_high(high,26) + donchian_low(low,26)) / 2),10))
strategy_roster.exit_long: crossbelow(ema((close - (donchian_high(high,52) + donchian_low(low,52)) / 2) - ((donchian_high(high,9) + donchian_low(low,9)) / 2 - (donchian_high(high,26) + donchian_low(low,26)) / 2),10),ema((close - (donchian_high(high,52) + donchian_low(low,52)) / 2) - ((donchian_high(high,9) + donchian_low(low,9)) / 2 - (donchian_high(high,26) + donchian_low(low,26)) / 2),10))
strategy_roster.notes: Tenkan/Kijun/Senkou Span B are built from Donchian midpoints at the standard 9/26/52 periods and the oscillator is smoothed with EMA(10) in place of the Jurik MA; crossing the oscillator's own previous value is expressed as crossabove(x,x). The lagging line, the forward plot shift and the percent stop/target parameters (no values documented) are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: EMA Cross MACD Session Start
strategy_roster.notes: The fast/slow EMA cross with a positive MACD histogram translates directly, using EMA(9)/EMA(21) and MACD(12,26) as stated defaults since no periods are documented. The session-start immediate entry and session-end flattening need a clock, which the DSL lacks.

strategy_roster.name: VWAP ADX Trend Strength
strategy_roster.notes: Session VWAP cannot be computed in the DSL, so the trend-change component uses a close crossing EMA(20) (stated default) while the documented AdxPeriod = 14 and AdxThreshold = 25 gate it, with a 20 exit level added by symmetry. ATR-multiple stops and the 5-minute candle type are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Reverse Keltner Channel
strategy_roster.notes: The Keltner channel is EMA(20) +/- 2x ATR(10) with the documented multipliers, the long entry is the re-entry cross back through the lower band, and WeakTrendOnly with AdxThreshold 25 becomes ADX(14) < 25. The half-channel-width stop is a dynamic ATR distance, not a percentage, so SL/TP stay null.

strategy_roster.name: Relative Currency Strength
strategy_roster.notes: The signal compares the traded pair's session return with the average of a basket of major currencies (threshold 0.01), which is inherently cross-sectional across instruments. A single OHLCV series cannot supply the basket, so the never-true guard is used.

strategy_roster.name: Highs Lows
strategy_roster.entry_long: (high + low) / 2 < (donchian_high(high,100) + donchian_low(low,100)) / 2 and ((high + low) / 2 - donchian_low(low,100)) / (donchian_high(high,100) - donchian_low(low,100) + 0.0001) * 100 < 15
strategy_roster.exit_long: (high + low) / 2 > (donchian_high(high,100) + donchian_low(low,100)) / 2 and ((high + low) / 2 - donchian_low(low,100)) / (donchian_high(high,100) - donchian_low(low,100) + 0.0001) * 100 > 85
strategy_roster.notes: The documented Range = 100 window supplies the highest and lowest values, the midpoint versus their average gives the side, and the normalized distance is compared with LowThreshold 15 and HighThreshold 85; the denominator is nudged to avoid a zero range. No stops are documented and the 240-minute candle type is not encoded.

strategy_roster.name: Expotest
strategy_roster.notes: Parabolic SAR is not in the DSL, so its long/short flip is approximated by a close beyond the prior 5-bar extreme (a stated default, the docs give no period), exiting on the mirrored break. The martingale-inspired sizing and the predefined stop/target have no documented values and are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: XAUUSD Simple 20 Profit 100 Loss
strategy_roster.notes: Entry depends only on position state and cooldown timers (15 minutes after a win, 12 hours after a loss) with USD PnL exits of 20/100, so no market-derived long condition exists. The never-true guard is used instead of inventing one.

strategy_roster.name: Big Runner
strategy_roster.notes: The documented close-over-fast-SMA and fast-over-slow-SMA double cross uses FastLength 5 and SlowLength 20, and the long protection is applied verbatim as StopLossLongPercent 2 and TakeProfitLongPercent 4. Portfolio-percent sizing, leverage and the short-side 7%/2% values are outside the engine.

strategy_roster.name: Optimized Grid with KNN
strategy_roster.notes: T3 is approximated by a triple-smoothed EMA with 5 and 20 as stated fast/slow defaults and the KNN average price change by a positive 10-bar ROC. The exit condition needs the stored lastEntryPrice, which the DSL cannot reference, and the grid sizing is not expressible.
